Package dev.px.core.input

Enum Class Key

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<Key>
dev.px.core.input.Key
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<Key>, Constable
public enum Key extends Enum<Key>
Platform-neutral keyboard key.

LWJGL 2 (1.8.x) and GLFW (1.13+) use different numeric key codes, so Core refuses to store either. Binds hold a Key, adapters translate at the boundary, and a config written on 1.8.9 loads unchanged on 1.21.
